steps.text: Brown 1/2 cup butter in a pan and let it cool.
Rub the remaining 1/2 cup butter into the flour, sugars, salt and oats until it clumps.
Press two thirds of the crumble into the tin, spread the jam, scatter the rest. Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes in a 9x9-inch tin.

answer.summary: I would halve both sugars. The bars will be less sweet and a little less chewy, since sugar holds moisture as well as sweetening.
tradeoffs: Less chew, and they will keep for fewer days.
The crumble will brown less, so judge it by colour rather than by the clock.
uncertainties: Sugar does more than sweeten here. Taste the crumble before you press it in.
